description: Agent-based diffusion and behavior adoption model on a community-structured contact network with policy interventions and misinformation dynamics. The model simulates daily contacts, information spread (true and misinformation), policy effects, and individual adoption decisions.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs a stochastic block model (community-structured) contact network with income-based homophily.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  create N=param.num_agents Person agents with attributes per initialization settings
  assign each agent to a community c in [0, param.num_communities-1] uniformly
  for each pair of agents (i,j):
    p = param.intra_community_p if community[i]==community[j] else param.inter_community_p
    # adjust for income homophily
    income_similarity = 1 - min(1, abs(income[i]-income[j]) / max_income_range)
    p_eff = p * (1 - param.homophily_by_income + param.homophily_by_income * income_similarity)
    add edge (i,j) with probability p_eff
  compute degree for each agent
  output network.graph and agents.population
else:
  pass
notes: Executed only at t=0; subsequent ticks do nothing.
Use vectorized or sparse methods to sample edges for performance.

modules.name: MobilityScheduler
modules.description: Generates daily contact events from the static network plus random mixing spillovers with durations.

update_rule.pseudocode:
contacts = []
for each agent i:
  base_contacts = Poisson(param.daily_contacts_mean)
  # Sample from neighbors in network
  neighbors = sample_without_replacement(neighbors(i), k = floor(base_contacts * (1 - param.mobility_mixing_rate)))
  for j in neighbors:
    duration = Exponential(mean=param.contact_duration_mean_min)
    contacts.append((i, j, duration))
  # Random mixing across network
  k_mix = base_contacts - len(neighbors)
  for m in 1..k_mix:
    j = uniform_random_agent_except(i)
    duration = Exponential(mean=param.contact_duration_mean_min)
    contacts.append((i, j, duration))
# Cap total extra contacts if needed
if len(contacts) > param.max_daily_new_edges:
  contacts = random_sample(contacts, param.max_daily_new_edges)
output contacts.today = contacts
notes: Durations are in minutes and feed into effective transmission.
Random mixing approximates mobility outside static ties.

modules.name: PolicyModule
modules.description: Determines policy levers (incentives, enforcement, and media campaigns) active each day and exposes their effects.

update_rule.pseudocode:
effects = {}
if t >= param.campaign_start_day:
  effects.media_strength = param.media_campaign_strength
else:
  effects.media_strength = 0.0
# Incentives and enforcement are active throughout (modifiable via scenario)
effects.incentive = param.incentive_amount
# For enforcement, compute per-contact penalty probability proxy
effects.enforcement = param.enforcement_rate
# Policy can reduce misinfo transmission multiplicatively
effects.mitigation_on_transmission = 1.0 - param.mitigation_effect_on_transmission
output policy.effects = effects
notes: Downstream modules read effects to adjust probabilities and utilities.

modules.name: InformationTransmission
modules.description: Spreads true information and misinformation across contacts; updates continuous belief levels with forgetting.

update_rule.pseudocode:
# optional exogenous misinformation shock
if t == param.misinfo_shock_day:
  for each agent i:
    agents[i].belief_misinfo = min(1.0, agents[i].belief_misinfo + param.misinfo_shock_magnitude)
# forgetting
for each agent i:
  agents[i].belief_true = max(0.0, agents[i].belief_true * (1 - param.forgetting_rate))
  agents[i].belief_misinfo = max(0.0, agents[i].belief_misinfo * (1 - param.forgetting_rate))
# transmission over contacts
for (i, j, duration) in contacts.today:
  dur_factor = duration / max(1e-6, mean_duration_reference)
  policy_scale = policy.effects.mitigation_on_transmission
  p_true = clamp(param.info_transmission_prob * dur_factor * policy_scale, 0, 1)
  p_mis  = clamp(param.misinfo_transmission_prob * dur_factor * policy_scale, 0, 1)
  # i to j
  if Bernoulli(p_true):
    delta = param.evidence_update_weight * agents[i].trust_neighbors
    agents[j].belief_true = min(1.0, agents[j].belief_true + delta)
  if Bernoulli(p_mis):
    delta = param.trust_neighbor_weight * agents[i].trust_neighbors
    agents[j].belief_misinfo = min(1.0, agents[j].belief_misinfo + delta)
  # j to i (symmetric)
  if Bernoulli(p_true):
    delta = param.evidence_update_weight * agents[j].trust_neighbors
    agents[i].belief_true = min(1.0, agents[i].belief_true + delta)
  if Bernoulli(p_mis):
    delta = param.trust_neighbor_weight * agents[j].trust_neighbors
    agents[i].belief_misinfo = min(1.0, agents[i].belief_misinfo + delta)
output agents.population
notes: mean_duration_reference should be computed as the running mean of contact_duration_mean_min upstream and passed implicitly; here modeled as constant = contact_duration_mean_min.
Belief updates are additive and bounded in [0,1].

modules.name: BehaviorAdoption
modules.description: Updates each agent's adoption state using social influence, beliefs, income-modulated compliance, and policy incentives/enforcement.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each agent i:
  neighbors = neighbors(i)
  if len(neighbors) > 0:
    s_i = mean(adoption_state[n] for n in neighbors)
  else:
    s_i = 0.0
  evidence_signal = clamp(agents[i].belief_true - agents[i].belief_misinfo, -1, 1)
  income_norm = clamp((agents[i].income - income_min)/(income_max - income_min + 1e-9), 0, 1)
  compliance_modifier = 1 + param.compliance_sensitivity_income * (1 - income_norm)
  policy_utility = policy.effects.incentive - policy.effects.enforcement
  utility = param.peer_influence_weight * s_i + evidence_signal - param.intrinsic_cost_adoption + policy_utility
  threshold = agents[i].adoption_threshold
  prob_adopt = 1 / (1 + exp(-(utility - threshold) / max(1e-6, param.logistic_temperature)))
  agents[i].adoption_state = Bernoulli(prob_adopt * compliance_modifier)
output agents.population
notes: Thresholds are heterogeneous and assigned at initialization.
Compliance increases among lower-income agents via compliance_modifier.

modules.name: ObservationAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates agent states into observable time series used for calibration and evaluation.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = len(agents)
adoption_rate = mean(agents[i].adoption_state for i in agents)
misinfo_prevalence = mean(1.0 if agents[i].belief_misinfo > 0.5 else 0.0 for i in agents)
mean_belief_true = mean(agents[i].belief_true for i in agents)
# optional observation noise
if param.observation_noise_std > 0:
  adoption_rate = clamp(Normal(adoption_rate, param.observation_noise_std), 0, 1)
  misinfo_prevalence = clamp(Normal(misinfo_prevalence, param.observation_noise_std), 0, 1)
  mean_belief_true = clamp(Normal(mean_belief_true, param.observation_noise_std), 0, 1)
output observable.adoption_rate_daily = adoption_rate
output observable.misinformation_prevalence_daily = misinfo_prevalence
output observable.mean_belief_true_daily = mean_belief_true
notes: Noise emulates measurement error in data.

algorithms.StochasticBlockModel: Generates a community-structured undirected graph with specified intra/inter probabilities and homophily scaling.
algorithms.PoissonContactSampling: Samples daily contacts per agent from a Poisson distribution and mixes across communities.
algorithms.IndependentCascadeVariant: Per-contact probabilistic transmission for true and misinformation adjusted by duration and policy.
algorithms.LogisticAdoption: Sigmoid adoption probability based on social signal, beliefs, costs, and policy incentives.
algorithms.GaussianObservationNoise: Adds bounded Gaussian noise to observables.
